igCaption:
Florida might owe you money 💸 and most people never check.

The state is holding about $4.5 billion in unclaimed money: old bank accounts, deposits, refunds, insurance payouts, uncashed checks. About 1 in 5 Floridians has some.

How to check (free):
1. Go to FLTreasureHunt.gov
2. Type your last + first name, leave city blank
3. If you show up: check the box → Claim → upload your ID
Claims take about 30–90 days. Never pay anyone to search for you.

In March alone Florida returned a record $92M, $18M of it to the Miami area.

Send this to someone who needs to check 👀
